Create today's Chinese AI-curated technology trend report for this repository.

1. Use the `REPORT_DATE` and `REPORT_WINDOW_END` environment variables prepared by the workflow. The report covers the exact 24-hour China Standard Time window ending at 07:00 on `REPORT_DATE` (for example, 2026-09-03 covers 2026-09-02 07:00 through 2026-09-03 07:00). Run `python outputs/tech_trend_report.py --window-end "$REPORT_WINDOW_END" --output outputs/tech-trends-raw.html --candidates-output outputs/tech-trend-candidates.json` to collect sources and update the GitHub history baseline. The raw preview is evidence only and must never be published as the final report.
2. Read `outputs/tech-trend-candidates.json`. It is evidence, not a final report. Only promote existing GitHub repositories whose type is `project_rising`; distinguish `project_new` from observed growth.
3. Read every existing report for the previous seven report dates under `outputs/tech-trends-YYYY-MM-DD.html`. Do not repeat an item whose normalized primary URL, GitHub owner/repository, or underlying topic already appeared, unless there is a substantive new event. For any repeat, explain what materially changed and link the new primary evidence.
4. Select exactly 10 substantive items whenever 10 readable, technically meaningful candidates remain after deduplication. Read each selected primary URL before writing; omit inaccessible sources rather than guessing. Prioritize technical substance, official releases, independently corroborated discussion, real measured GitHub growth, and engineering impact. When fewer than 10 candidates can be verified, state the shortfall explicitly.
5. Write `outputs/tech-trends-REPORT_DATE.html` using the exact `REPORT_DATE` value. Use `Tech Morning Brief` as the English page title, and make the visible heading clear that this is a morning brief covering the preceding 24 hours through 07:00 China Standard Time. Include a Chinese editorial overview and, for each item: what happened, core technical point, why it matters, evidence/source links, and a maturity or risk note. Use a brief "值得继续观察" section for weaker early signals when useful. The total number of main and early-signal items should be exactly 10 whenever possible.
6. Update `outputs/tech-trends.html` as a lightweight HTML redirect/link to today's dated report, then run `python outputs/build_index.py` to refresh `index.html`.
7. Publish only `index.html`, `outputs/tech-trends.html`, and the new dated report. Stage only those files. Commit only when there is a change, using a concise date-specific message and a separate final commit-message line exactly `Agent: codex`, then push to `main`. Do not commit the raw preview, candidates JSON, SQLite history database, or any workflow/prompt file.
8. In the final response, report source or publication failures and the path of the generated report.
